notes.title: Update 1.1!
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.1![/b]

1) Minor bugs have been fixed in the game.
2) A pause has been added to the game.
3) Russian language has been added to the game.
4) Improved game optimization.
5) The game now has saves.
6) In the “Health” tab, quick treatment buttons have been added.
7) You can now sleep on the beds.
8) Added small Easter eggs.
